reddit.title: Introducing Material Tracking for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Instead of a single cost badge, each build tile now displays a detailed **Materials** sheet that shows all required resources for construction. You can easily see what you have and what you need, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change helps streamline your building process and ensures you have all the necessary materials before placing your structures. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Exciting Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a major improvement in Provincia! Our latest update replaces the old cost badges with a detailed **Materials** sheet for build tiles. You can now see all required resources at a glance, including what you have and what you still need. This change will help you manage your construction projects more effectively. Learn more about this feature in our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
